The scenarios below reflect the kinds of home loan challenges our broker network helps Brisbane clients work through, so treat them as a starting point and speak with a broker about yours. First Home Buyer | First Home Buyers, Brisbane "Young couple saving for their first home in inner Brisbane. Limited deposit and unsure about Queensland government grants and schemes." Solution: A specialist first home buyer broker can identify FHBG eligibility and QLD First Home Owner Grant options, potentially enabling purchase with a 5% deposit and no LMI — saving thousands in upfront costs. Refinancing | Homeowner, Brisbane Southside "Brisbane homeowner on an older variable rate who had not reviewed their loan in several years and was likely paying well above current market rates." Solution: A refinance specialist can compare 100+ lenders to find better rates, potentially with cashback offers — annual savings on repayments can be significant over the life of the loan. Investment Loan | Property Investor, Inner Brisbane "Experienced investor looking to purchase a second investment property in the inner suburbs, needing to access existing equity and structure loans for tax efficiency." Solution: An investment lending specialist can structure loans across multiple properties, arrange interest-only periods, and access lenders with favourable investor policies — maximising borrowing capacity.
